label: Bible Study
prompt: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the _____ to every creature.
verse: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
note: The Great Commission, Mark's edition — all the world, every creature.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is _____. And they began to be merry.
verse: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.
note: The prodigal's welcome-home banner: dead-alive, lost-found. Then the party starts.

label: Sunday School
prompt: My God hath sent his _____, and hath shut the lions' mouths, that they have not hurt me: forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me; and also before thee, O king, have I done no hurt.
verse: My God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions' mouths, that they have not hurt me: forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me; and also before thee, O king, have I done no hurt.
note: Daniel's morning report from the lions' den: God's angel worked the night shift.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not _____ thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.
verse: But if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.
note: The bravest 'but if not' ever spoken — the three friends trusted God's power without demanding the rescue.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not _____ to be equal with God:
verse: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
note: He 'thought it not robbery' to be equal with God — equality wasn't stolen goods; it was his.
